comments.content: The variable `rootResolved` is assigned in both branches of the try/catch but is never read or returned. The `ContainmentResult` interface does not include a `rootResolved` field, so this variable serves no purpose. It appears to be leftover from a design where root resolution status was intended to be tracked (similar to how `resolved` tracks target resolution), but was never wired in. If root resolution status is intentionally omitted, this dead variable should be removed to avoid misleading future maintainers.
